# Codex Sol/Luna Switchable v0.3.0

Install once and use Codex normally.

## Highlights

- Root model and reasoning remain user-selected.
- Normal usage is `python scripts/install.py apply` once, then `codex`.
- Bounded exploration, research, implementation, testing, and review can be delegated to GPT-6 Luna.
- Luna roles use private `csl_luna_*` identifiers and plugin-owned role files.
- The installer preserves unrelated Codex configuration; MCP, providers, hooks, permissions, and project configuration are outside plugin ownership.
- Safe migration from v0.2.x with guarded plan, apply, status, on, off, rollback, and uninstall operations.
- Legacy profiles remain Advanced / Compatibility material and are not the normal user entry point.
- Fast remains whole-session Fast; Luna-only Fast is not advertised.

## Compatibility

The project was validated against codex-cli 0.155.0-alpha.16 capability behavior. Stable 0.155.0+ remains the documented compatibility target. Luna context-window and auto-compact values are configured overrides; independent runtime context-window telemetry is unavailable.
